note: Damage-affecting relics only. Each has 3 levels; only level-3 values are confirmed, L1/L2 are guesses. mode 'mult' + group: percentages in the same group (relic + weapon bonus) SUM, then the group multiplies the total - per the research thread's stacking tests. mode 'add' joins the additive pool. requires gates on a status toggle.
